overview: Vulnerability programmes in retail estates usually drown in their own output: a scanner produces tens of thousands of findings, remediation capacity handles a fraction, and the fraction chosen is rarely the one an attacker would have used. Falcon Exposure Management uses the sensor already on the endpoints to see what is actually installed and reachable, and prioritises accordingly. The value is entirely in the prioritisation, so the honest measure is whether the highest-priority set actually shrinks rather than how many findings exist.
